questions.question: There are 8 rows of chairs with 6 chairs in each row. How many chairs are there altogether?
A box contains 9 packs of crayons. Each pack has 7 crayons. How many crayons are there?
A baker made 12 trays of cookies. Each tray has 8 cookies. How many cookies did the baker make?
A classroom has 10 tables. Each table seats 4 students. How many students can sit altogether?
A farmer has 8 baskets with 7 apples in each basket. He sells 12 apples. How many apples are left?
A toy store receives 9 boxes. Each box contains 12 toy cars. If 15 toy cars are sold, how many remain?
There are 6 teams with 8 players on each team. If 9 players are absent, how many players are present?
A school buys 12 packs of pencils. Each pack has 9 pencils. Then 28 pencils are given away. How many pencils remain?
A movie theater has 11 rows with 12 seats in each row. If 37 seats are empty, how many seats are occupied?
